mission.brief: Create /home/learner/worksheet.txt with the same contents as /opt/reference/worksheet.txt, preserve the original unchanged, and read your final copy. Reading the source alone does not verify your copy.
constraints: All paths and files are virtual. Commands act immediately; there is no Apply step and no host access.
Use only the syntax in Command reference. No quotes, wildcards, shell expansion, pipes, recursion, links, archives, or unsupported options.
Relative and absolute paths are equivalent. The final state and explicitly named activity evidence earn credit; no exact transcript is required.
File-management commands may change only descendants of /home/learner. Other paths and mutation-root nodes are pinned.
Any actual filesystem change clears cat/find verification. Read or discover the final result again. Skipped no-clobber commands do not clear evidence.

objectives.label: Final state: working copy matches the reference
Action: read the final working copy after changes

hints: A copy creates another file; it should leave the source available.
cp requires -n in this bounded simulation. An existing target is skipped, so inspect it rather than assuming it changed.

/opt/reference/worksheet.txt.content: Worksheet: identify paths before changing files.

lesson.goal: Copy the reference without replacing the original, then read the final copy.

steps.explanation: cp copies one regular file here. -n avoids overwriting an existing destination.
The reference stays in place; copying and moving are different operations.
Read the destination after the final change to verify your result.
steps.expected: Worksheet: identify paths before changing files.
